units: Ter. VIII, 8 היתה מונחת במקום הת׳ … המוצנע (Ar. התּוֹרֶף) if it (the jar of unclean wine) was lying in a neglected place, he must put it in a decent place.—Trnsf. obscenity; מקום בית הת׳, הת׳ pudenda.

<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 8:1">Nidd. VIII, 1</cite> <he>בית הת׳</he>; a. e.—Tanḥ. Vayetsé 12 (expl. <cite ref="V01050"><he>תְּרָפִים</he></cite>) <he>מעשה תורף וכ׳</he> works of filth, works of uncleanness.
<cite ref="Shevuot 16a:9">Shebu. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>מפני שת׳ של ירושלים היתה וכ׳</he> (or <he>שתּוֹרְפָהּ</he>) because it was the weak point of Jerusalem, and could easily be captured.
